name: Hanafubuki ~Sennen no Koi o Shimashita~
original_name: 桜吹雪～千年の恋をしました～
source:
Kazunari joins a school as a scholarship student since he lost his parents a while ago. His school is, however, super-rich and he feels somewhat out of place. One day, he saves a female student, Akasha, who was being chased by someone. Akasha is actually from a rich family and now works as the chief manager of school festival. Like this, he starts working with her...

[From ErogeShop]
